title: Part
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. On the first face, draw a 2D sketch that consists of a closed loop. Start by drawing the first arc from the point (0.0, 0.0032) to (0.0009, 0.0009) and then to (0.0032, 0.0). Follow this with the first line from (0.0032, 0.0) to (0.0159, 0.0). Continue with the second arc from (0.0159, 0.0) to (0.0181, 0.0009) and then to (0.0191, 0.0032). Draw the second line from (0.0191, 0.0032) to (0.0191, 0.0159). Next, draw the third arc from (0.0191, 0.0159) to (0.0181, 0.0181) and then to (0.0159, 0.0191). Add the third line from (0.0159, 0.0191) to (0.0032, 0.0191). Complete the loop with the fourth arc from (0.0032, 0.0191) to (0.0009, 0.0181) and then to (0.0, 0.0159). Finally, draw the fourth line from (0.0, 0.0159) back to (0.0, 0.0032). Scale the 2D sketch by a factor of 0.0191. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into 3D by applying the same Euler angles and translation vector used initially. Extrude the 2D sketch 0.75 units along the normal direction without extruding in the opposite direction. Create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The dimensions of the final part are a length of 0.01906779661016949 units, a width of 0.01906779661016949 units, and a height of 0.7499999999999999 units.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0, 0.0032).threePointArc((0.0009, 0.0009), (0.0032, 0.0)).lineTo(0.0159, 0.0).threePointArc((0.0181, 0.0009), (0.0191, 0.0032)).lineTo(0.0191, 0.0159).threePointArc((0.0181, 0.0181), (0.0159, 0.0191)).lineTo(0.0032, 0.0191).threePointArc((0.0009, 0.0181), (0.0, 0.0159)).close()

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.75)

# Final model
r = extrusion

import cadquery as cq

# Overall bounding box: X=0.0191, Y=0.0191, Z=0.7500
# The part is a thin square rod (slightly rounded corners) extruded along Z.

w = 0.0191      # width in X and Y
h = 0.7500      # height in Z
corner_r = 0.002  # small corner radius

r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .rect(w, w)
    .extrude(h)
    .edges("|Z")
    .fillet(corner_r)
)
